descripcion: CSS de apoyo para lo que Elementor (versión gratis) no hace con sus controles: textura de cuadrícula, brillos radiales, botón degradado en hover, borde degradado del ticket de precio, barra superior fija y CTA fijo en móvil. Va PRIMERO en structure.json; las demás secciones del arquetipo evento lo usan vía clases gx-*.
notas: Los colores salen de la marca del curso (primary, secondary, primary_soft, surface_dark). Las clases se asignan en Avanzado → Clases CSS de cada contenedor/widget.

settings.html:
<style>
.gx-grid{background-image:linear-gradient(color-mix(in srgb,{{marca.colores.primary_soft.hex}} 7%,transparent) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,{{marca.colores.primary_soft.hex}} 7%,transparent) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:56px 28px}
.gx-glow,.gx-glow-center{overflow:hidden}
.gx-glow:before{content:"";position:absolute;right:-10%;top:10%;width:640px;height:640px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,color-mix(in srgb,{{marca.colores.secondary.hex}} 22%,transparent),transparent 65%);pointer-events:none}
.gx-glow-center:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:900px;height:520px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 35% 50%,color-mix(in srgb,{{marca.colores.primary.hex}} 30%,transparent),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 65% 50%,color-mix(in srgb,{{marca.colores.secondary.hex}} 30%,transparent),transparent 60%);pointer-events:none}
.gx-glow>.e-con-inner,.gx-glow-center>.e-con-inner{position:relative;z-index:1}
.gx-sticky-top{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50}
.gx-btn .elementor-button{transition:filter .12s,transform .12s}
.gx-btn .elementor-button:hover,.gx-btn .elementor-button:focus{background-image:linear-gradient(135deg,{{marca.colores.primary.hex}},{{marca.colores.secondary.hex}})!important;color:#fff!important;filter:brightness(1.08)}
.gx-btn .elementor-button:active{transform:scale(.98)}
.gx-ticket{border:2px solid transparent!important;background:linear-gradient(color-mix(in srgb,#fff 4%,{{marca.colores.surface_dark.hex}}),color-mix(in srgb,#fff 4%,{{marca.colores.surface_dark.hex}})) padding-box,linear-gradient(135deg,{{marca.colores.primary.hex}},{{marca.colores.secondary.hex}}) border-box!important}
.gx-cut{position:relative}
.gx-cut:before,.gx-cut:after{content:"";position:absolute;top:50%;width:30px;height:30px;margin-top:-15px;border-radius:50%;background:{{marca.colores.surface_dark.hex}}}
.gx-cut:before{left:-43px}.gx-cut:after{right:-43px}
.gx-chip{display:inline-block}
@media (max-width:767px){
  .gx-sticky-cta{position:fixed!important;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:60;transform:translateY(110%);transition:transform .25s}
  .gx-scrolled .gx-sticky-cta{transform:none}
  body{padding-bottom:76px}
}
</style>
<script>(function(){function t(){document.documentElement.classList.toggle('gx-scrolled',window.scrollY>700)}addEventListener('scroll',t,{passive:true});t();})();</script>
